create_value_model: create a ValueModel with belief_size, state_size, and hidden_size parameters for value estimation
create_q_function_model: create a ValueModel with action_size parameter to use as a Q function network
forward_value_prediction: forward a latent state tensor through the ValueModel to get scalar value predictions
forward_q_value_with_action: forward a latent state and action tensor through the ValueModel to get Q values
forward_feature_directly: forward a pre-computed feature tensor through the ValueModel using forward_feature method
